name: Freixenet Gratien
about: Freixenet Gratien is a wine company with its head office at 208 Quai de Paludate in Bordeaux. It was registered in 1997. Business France traces its Bordeaux side to Yvon Mau, a négociant that gives 1897 as its start and that the Spanish cava house Freixenet bought in 2001.
The company makes still wines, from Vin de France to IGP and AOP, under château and brand names. The Pierre Jean Colombard Chardonnay, a Vin de France, is bottled for it.
